Between iterations nothing is armed; the next iteration re-arms, and the arm's synchronous drain picks up whatever arrived meanwhile, so nothing is lost. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [n]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[256]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The maximum batch size; must be at least 1. [A]{.doc-parameter-name} : [the]{.doc-parameter-name} : [cannot]{.doc-parameter-name} : [channel]{.doc-parameter-name} : ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#16cac2ed .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pymizu with pymizu.Channel.create(''' import pymizu for _ in range(3): ch.send(ch.recv()) ''') as ch: ch.send_batch([1, 2, 3]) batches = [] async for batch in ch.iter_batches_async(): batches.append(batch) [x for batch in batches for x in batch] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` [1, 2, 3] ``` ::: :::
